evidence_items.explanation: The ruling applied existing consent and disclosure protections to AI-generated voice calls and became effective on release. It was a concrete federal response relevant to deceptive impersonation calls, subject to statutory exemptions.

evidence_items.locator: Section 2, Use of Deep Fake Technology to Influence an Election, effective-date provision

receipt.public_excerpt: This section is effective August 1, 2023, and applies to crimes committed on or after that date.

evidence_items.explanation: Section 2 criminalized specified nonconsensual dissemination of deepfakes within 90 days of an election when intended to injure a candidate or influence the result. This enacted, operative restriction directly addressed election misinformation.
